# Select responses for each dimension

Select responses for each dimension

## Usage

``` r
icc_cfa(eta, gamma, lambda, psi)
```

## Arguments

- eta:

  eta or ability

- gamma:

  gamma or threshold

- lambda:

  lambda or loading

- psi:

  psi or error

## Examples

icc_cfa(seq(-6,6,.1),1,1,1)
